tweets.text: We've been quickly iterating on improving Muse Spark's coding agent capability since the 1.1 launch less than a month ago and produced Muse Spark 1.2 + our own harness Muse Code with enhanced coding performance in daily software engineering, long-horizon tasks, auto-research and so on. Please try it out via one command line install: curl -fsS https://t.co/5cqPzgztI2 | bash

author.name: Tianhe (Kevin) Yu
author.description: AI Research Scientist @meta MSL TBD. Previously @GoogleDeepMind driving Gemini post-training and RL. Co-created Gemini Deep Think. PhD from @StanfordAILab.

quoted_tweet.text: Releasing Muse Code in beta today. It's a terminal coding agent that takes on complete software engineering tasks across large repos: planning changes, writing code, validating the results. Powered by Muse Spark 1.2, a coding-focused model update. https://t.co/xqavk41w6v
